attchmntText: Trent Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation of schedule of Analyst / Institutional Investors Meetings
voiceSummary: Trent Limited has intimated the schedule of meetings with analysts and institutional investors pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Northcape Capital, Australia, represented by Jefferies, will hold a one-to-one meeting on 25th November 2026. JP Morgan Asset Management, Hong Kong, is scheduled for 26th November 2026. Bernstein will meet on 30th November 2026. Wellington Management is set for 4th December 2026. All meetings are one-to-one. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies on either side. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during these meetings. The company secretary, Krupa Anandpara, filed this notice for information and records.

attchmntText: Trent Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating
voiceSummary: Trent Limited intimates that CARE Ratings Limited re-affirmed the credit rating on its Commercial Papers on 16th November 2026 at 3.17 p.m. The rating for Commercial Papers is CARE A1+. The limit for these Commercial Papers has been enhanced to ₹ 750 Crore from ₹ 500 Crore. This information is available on the company website at https://trentlimited.com/.

attchmntText: Trent Limited has informed the Exchange about Reminder letter to  shareholders to Dematerialise the Shares
voiceSummary: Trent Limited issued a reminder on 13th November 2026 to shareholders holding physical shares to dematerialize them. The company cites SEBI regulations prohibiting the transfer of physical shares since April 1, 2021, and the issuance of new physical certificates since January 2022. Shareholders are urged to contact their Depository Participant to convert physical holdings into demat form. The letter outlines benefits including convenient holding, immediate transfer, reduced paperwork, and direct credit for corporate actions. The Registrar and Share Transfer Agent is MUFG Intime India Private Limited. Queries can be directed to them at Mumbai. The intimation is also placed on the company website.
